uiStatus: Existing product UI handoff, scripted content; not a live production screen recording
gameplay: Illustrative simulation with staged player movement, dialogue, choice, inventory, gate and return-state response

shots.title:
Start with
a world.
shots.note:
Give the Agent a setting
and a playable idea.
shots.prompt: Create an RPG in a city where memories are currency.
shots.reply: I’ll start with the city, its streets and a central gate.

shots.title: A city takes shape.
shots.note: Your setting becomes a place to explore.

shots.title:
Give someone
a story.
shots.note:
Describe who you play
and who matters to them.
shots.prompt: Make me a forgotten courier. Add one friend who still remembers me.
shots.reply: Adding the courier and a companion who recognises them.

shots.title: You are the courier.
shots.note: A role. A motive. A reason to begin.

shots.title: One person remembers.
shots.note: A relationship gives the journey meaning.

shots.title:
Turn a premise
into a choice.
shots.note:
Say what the player can do
and what should happen.
shots.prompt: Two guards block the gate. Let me show the letter or trade a memory.
shots.reply: The letter earns their trust. Trading a memory costs one memory. Either choice opens the gate.

shots.title: Now there is a decision.
shots.note: The gate. The guards. The sealed letter.

shots.title:
Try what
you made.
shots.note:
Open Preview.
Play the first encounter.
shots.reply: The first encounter is ready to preview.

shots.title:
Play. Notice.
Ask again.
shots.note:
Keep refining the rules
in the same conversation.
shots.prompt: Make the guards remember me and let me pass next time.
shots.reply: I’ll save their trust. When you return, they’ll recognise you and open the gate.
